doc.title: Harry "Sweets" Edison interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, September 3, 1995

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Thanks so much for your time.
And thank you for inviting me.
It was my pleasure. And maybe we can do it again sometime.
We’d love to. Because I know you’ve got more great stories and more wisdom for us. On behalf of the Hamilton College Jazz Archive, thanks to Sweets Edison, and we’ll be seeing you in a few months.
I hope so. I’m looking forward to it. I’m looking forward. Thank you for inviting me.
